At the 70th position, **LongChat-13B (16K) reaches roughly 35–36% accuracy** in the 140 key-value pairs (~8K tokens) setting (page 1, Figure 7, center panel).

This is an estimate read from the plot. The document does not state the exact value in text, and the point sits just below the 40% gridline.

For context, LongChat is the gray dashed line in that panel (page 1):
- At the 1st and 35th positions it stays around the high 30s.
- At the 70th position it reaches its lowest point.
- It then rises to about 66% at the 105th position and about 88% at the 140th.

The text on page 1 also notes that when the relevant information is at the start of the context, LongChat-13B (16K) "tends to generate code to retrieve the key, rather than outputting the value directly." This explains its low accuracy at early positions.
